meta.title: Duncan & Wright tieback, active
meta.notes: Homogeneous slope with a 9000 lb/ft tieback applied horizontally at mid-height as an active force, on the reference printed GLE circle. Converted to SI.

source.reference: Duncan & Wright, Soil Strength and Slope Stability, fig. 6.34.
source.derived_from: cSlope verification problem V035a (MIT License), https://github.com/ZilanCiftci/cslope
notes: commercial program A's Bishop (1.531) and Spencer (1.884) belong to their own critical circles; on this circle cSlope's Bishop is 1.568. Duncan & Wright 1.51.

Duncan, Wright & Brandon (2014, Fig. 6.36, p. 116, the 1st edition's fig. 6.34) give no slip surface or method for 1.51; it belongs to their own critical surface. The unreinforced slope gives 0.91; the factor on the anchor force alone 4.82.
cSlope fija options.tolerance = 0.001 (tolerancia del solver) en sus checks; no se importa: ogs usa analysis.tolerance = 1e-05.
